DIV8.HEAD: § 1006.14 Harassing, oppressive, or abusive conduct.
DIV8.P: (a) [Synthetic fixture text.] In general. A debt collector must not engage in conduct the natural consequence of which is to harass.
(b)(2) Telephone call frequencies. A debt collector is presumed to comply if it places a telephone call not more than seven times within seven consecutive days.
(h) Prohibited communication media. A debt collector must not communicate through a medium the consumer has requested it not use.
